title: Primary generic filtration with a sheaf-level trace retraction
statement: Let k,C,f and the finite normalization model hypothesis be with C an integral smooth affine connected curve and every finite extension of its function field admitting a finite integral smooth affine connected normalization whose generic point is compatibly identified with that extension, using [def-sc-curves, def-sc-function-field, def-fin-normalization-extension]. Let ell be prime and M an abelian etale sheaf on Spec C.functionField with finite ell-primary geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. There is a finite morphism pi:D -> C with D integral, smooth affine connected over k, and a finite generic chain F(0)=0,...,F(n) on D. Every quotient is a finite iterated binary biproduct of the constant Z/ell sheaf [def-sc-constant-sheaves], including dimension zero. The sheaf eta_C* M is a retract of pi_* eta_D* F(n), by maps a,b with a followed by b equal to identity. This asserts no cohomology or injection into a product.

proof.text: Identify M with a finite primary continuous Galois module. Apply the Sylow filtration to obtain an open subgroup H of index coprime to ell and an H-invariant chain with trivial quotients killed by ell.

Take the finite separable fixed field L of H and identify its degree with the subgroup index. Restriction corresponds to inverse image on Spec L. Transport the chain to sheaves over L; choose bases of its finite ZMod ell quotients to obtain the specified finite binary biproducts. Use terminal chain terms beyond n and allow repeated terms and n=0.

Use hmodel for L, taking its normalization D and the supplied generic isomorphism. Normalization in a field is integral. Transport the chain along that isomorphism, including its zero and short exact sequence identifications.

A power ell^e annihilates the finite primary stalk and hence M by faithfulness. Restriction followed by trace is degree multiplication. Bezout gives s times the degree equal to one modulo ell^e, so rescaled trace retracts restriction. Apply generic direct image and the composition isomorphisms; the compatibility in hmodel conjugates the middle sheaf to pi_* eta_D*F(n). Functoriality preserves the retraction identity.

theorem exists_generic_primary_coarse_trace_retraction
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C] [IsIntegral C]
    (hmodel : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra C.functionField L]
      [FiniteDimensional C.functionField L],
      IsFinite (C.fromNormalizationIn L) ∧ IsAffine (C.normalizationIn L) ∧
        IsConnectedCurve (C.fromNormalizationIn L ≫ f) ∧
        Smooth (C.fromNormalizationIn L ≫ f) ∧
        ∃ e : Spec (.of L) ≅ Spec (C.normalizationIn L).functionField,
          e.hom ≫ (C.normalizationIn L).fromSpecFunctionField =
            (C.fromSpecOfAlgebraFunctionField L).toNormalization)
    (M : Sheaf (Spec C.functionField).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime)
    (hfinite : Finite (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap C.functionField (AlgebraicClosure C.functionField))))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M))
    (hprimary : IsPGroup ℓ (Multiplicative (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap C.functionField (AlgebraicClosure C.functionField))))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M))) :
    ∃ (D : Scheme.{u}) (π : D ⟶ C), IsFinite π ∧
      IsConnectedCurve (π ≫ f) ∧ Smooth (π ≫ f) ∧ IsAffine D ∧
      ∃ hIntegral : IsIntegral D,
      letI : IsIntegral D := hIntegral;
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Sheaf (Spec D.functionField).smallEtaleTopology
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
        IsZero (F 0) ∧
        (∀ (a : ℕ), a < n →
          ∃ (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Spec D.functionField).smallEtaleTopology
              AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (d : ℕ),
            S.ShortExact ∧ Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ F a) ∧
              Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ F (a + 1)) ∧
              Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ Nat.rec (0 : _)
                (fun _ A ↦ A ⊞ (Spec D.functionField).constantZMod ℓ) d)) ∧
        ∃ (a : (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} C.fromSpecFunctionField).obj M ⟶
            (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} π).obj
              ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} D.fromSpecFunctionField).obj (F n)))
          (b : (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} π).obj
              ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} D.fromSpecFunctionField).obj (F n)) ⟶
            (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} C.fromSpecFunctionField).obj M),
          a ≫ b = 𝟙 _
